general.owner_only: Only the workspace owner can change these settings

storyarn_ai.title: Storyarn AI
storyarn_ai.description: Allow eligible members to run bounded Storyarn AI tools using this workspace's promotional AI allowance. This setting does not enable personal keys or any paid service.
storyarn_ai.toggle_label: Allow Storyarn AI for this workspace
storyarn_ai.owner_only: Only the workspace owner can change this policy.
storyarn_ai.disclosure: Authorized task content leaves Storyarn and is processed by {provider} using {model} in the configured {region} location, with zero data retention and no model-training use. Storyarn records content-free usage and cost metadata.
storyarn_ai.route_unavailable: Storyarn AI remains blocked until the operator has verified and configured the managed provider, processing location, zero data retention, and no-training policy.

personal_ai.title: Personal AI for members
personal_ai.badge: Their own keys · billed by their provider
personal_ai.description: The workspace owner can always use their own personal AI connections. Enable this policy to let other eligible members explicitly run supported tools with provider accounts they connected themselves. Their keys remain private and never consume this workspace's Storyarn AI allowance.
personal_ai.toggle_label: Allow other members to use their personal AI keys in this workspace
personal_ai.owner_only: Only the workspace owner can allow personal AI for other members.
personal_ai.disclosure: Authorized project content leaves Storyarn and is processed under each member's provider account. Processing region, retention and possible model-training use depend on that provider and account; Storyarn cannot guarantee zero retention or no training for personal keys. Each member must review the disclosed data scope and consent before first use.

danger_zone.title: Danger Zone
